description:
ML.NET is a machine learning framework for .NET. ML.NET supports sentiment analysis, price prediction, fraud detection, and more using custom models.

Machine Learning for .NET: Brings machine learning capabilities to .NET applications. Model Training and Deployment: Facilitates the entire machine learning lifecycle. Support for Various Algorithms: Includes classification, regression, clustering, and more. Integration with Visual Studio: Provides tools within the Visual Studio environment.
